steps.content: Dark debris rushes into Furor, gradually gathering into a solid form in the sky. The massive Apostle of Ashes has taken the bait. It fixes its attention on the feast before it.

steps.speaker: Fragmented Whispers
steps.content: Come, stay, become one with us... You shall never leave...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Of course. I alone should suffice to satisfy your hunger.

Wounds cover Hypatia's body. The crystallized Mania begins to turn against her, creeping up toward her shoulder blades. The crystal embedded in the metal trembles violently, as if about to shatter at any moment.
She tries to draw out even greater power from the Aurum Secretum, but the burden becomes too much, and the metal in her arm suddenly explodes.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Has the Aurum Secretum reached its limit? No... Damn it, I'm running out of time...
There's never time for hesitation on the battlefield. Another attack comes howling toward her, and it's too late to dodge!
At the critical moment, an attack descends from above, interrupting the Apostle's assault.
Traffic control in progress! Everyone, <size=44>MAKE</size> <size=50>WAY</size> NOW!
Hypatia looks up in shock, seeing a silhouette standing high above against the light.
